QA, Reconciliation & Reliability.label: QA, Reconciliation & Reliability
QA, Reconciliation & Reliability.description: Data QA, reconciliation, preview gates, PDF fixes, manifests and stabilization work.

Publishing & Reporting History.label: Publishing & Reporting History

Scale Intelligence Roadmap.label: Scale Intelligence Roadmap

milestones.title: Client-report prototype foundation
milestones.description: Established the initial Autodesk-style client report pattern with branded hero, executive metrics, filters, account/GEO analysis, audience analysis, and client-facing presentation.
milestones.why: Provided the reference experience that the reusable builder later needed to generate instead of hand-coding each report.
milestones.notes: Grounded in the Autodesk Four-Touch Client/Internal report prototype; represented in August as the official product origin.

milestones.title: Client / Internal presentation modes
milestones.description: Created separate Client View and Internal View behavior so the client could receive a controlled report while the AVANI team retained additional review and management controls.
milestones.why: Made one report useful for both client delivery and internal QA without maintaining two separate files.
milestones.notes: Grounded in the Autodesk Client/Internal report and add-on guide.

milestones.title: Protected Internal view access
milestones.description: Added an internal-password field to the report setup so AVANI-only report controls and analysis could be separated from the client-facing view within the same generated report.
milestones.why: Protected internal-only reporting context while preserving a single report artifact for client delivery and AVANI review.
milestones.notes: Grounded in the August 3 Universal Report Builder v1 source, which includes an Internal password in report setup.

milestones.title: Export Summary control
milestones.description: Added an internal control to create a summary from the active report and current filters.
milestones.why: Made the report operationally useful beyond on-screen viewing.

milestones.title: Editable client menus
milestones.description: Added internal controls for choosing which report sections are visible in the client experience.
milestones.why: Allowed the report experience to be tailored without rebuilding the whole output.

milestones.title: Print / PDF output
milestones.description: Added a clean static-output path for client-ready printing and PDF generation after the active view was reviewed.
milestones.why: Provided a portable client-facing format in addition to the interactive HTML report.

milestones.title: Interactive report filtering
milestones.description: Added filters for account, geography and other supported dimensions so report sections could be explored without regenerating the file.
milestones.why: Turned the report from a static readout into an interactive client analysis experience.

milestones.title: Executive performance readout
milestones.description: Introduced an executive summary layer above detailed tables and charts to explain the campaign story before the supporting analysis.
milestones.why: Made the report easier for client stakeholders to consume at a glance.

milestones.title: Account & GEO report view
milestones.description: Created a dedicated account and geographic analysis experience with account concentration, geographic coverage, and map-oriented reporting.
milestones.why: Expanded the report beyond lead volume into where program reach was actually occurring.

milestones.title: TAL coverage visibility
milestones.description: Added target-account-list coverage and match-rate reporting for named-account programs.
milestones.why: Made account-program delivery measurable against the supplied target account list.

milestones.title: Universal Report Builder foundation
milestones.description: Established the reusable AVANI REPORT BUILDER™ shell with report setup, builder controls, generated-report preview, validation, and standalone output.
milestones.why: Converted a one-off report into reusable software that could generate multiple client reports.
milestones.notes: Verified in the August Universal Report Builder lineage.

milestones.title: Report setup & client identity
milestones.description: Added reusable report setup fields for client name, client slug, report title, reporting period, prepared date, campaign model, and strategic context.
milestones.why: Moved client-specific context into configuration instead of hard-coded report text.

milestones.title: Campaign type & multi-touch configuration
milestones.description: Added support for 1 Touch, 2 Touch, 3 Touch, 4 Touch and Multiple Touch campaign structures so the generated report could adapt to different syndication models.
milestones.why: Allowed one builder to support multiple campaign designs rather than only the original four-touch example.

milestones.title: Reporting calendar configuration
milestones.description: Added reporting-period and prepared-date handling so generated reports display the correct reporting context.
milestones.why: Made report timing configurable and reusable across client reporting periods.

milestones.title: CSV / XLS / XLSX campaign ingestion
milestones.description: Added campaign-delivery upload support across CSV and Excel formats with the first worksheet used where applicable.
milestones.why: Reduced manual source conversion and made the builder practical for real campaign files.

milestones.title: TAL / Named Account ingestion
milestones.description: Added optional target-account / named-account upload with automatic account or domain detection where supported.
milestones.why: Enabled the same builder to support both open campaigns and account-list-driven programs.

milestones.title: Intent & enrichment signal ingestion
milestones.description: Added optional account-level intent and enrichment inputs such as brand intent, product intent, clicks, sessions, website activity, topic cluster, and buying stage.
milestones.why: Created a path for the report to incorporate account-level context beyond campaign-delivery rows.

milestones.title: Automatic campaign-field mapping
milestones.description: Added automatic detection and mapping of uploaded source columns into the builder’s expected report fields.
milestones.why: Reduced repetitive setup when source files use different column names.

milestones.title: Manual mapping correction
milestones.description: Allowed auto-mapped campaign fields to be reviewed and adjusted inside the builder before report generation.
milestones.why: Kept automation flexible when a source file needed human correction.

milestones.title: Required-field validation
milestones.description: Added validation feedback around required inputs and data readiness before preview/export.
milestones.why: Caught source problems before they reached the client-facing report.

milestones.title: Configurable report modules
milestones.description: Added a module directory so report capabilities could remain available while the generated output selected the relevant sections for a program.
milestones.why: Made the builder extensible rather than tied to one fixed report structure.

milestones.title: Restore Demo workflow
milestones.description: Added a reusable demo restore path so the builder could be tested and demonstrated without preparing a new source file every time.
milestones.why: Created a repeatable test fixture for builder validation and internal demonstrations.

milestones.title: In-builder generated report preview
milestones.description: Added a live preview pane that renders the generated client report directly alongside the builder configuration.
milestones.why: Allowed QA and visual review before exporting or publishing.

milestones.title: Standalone HTML export
milestones.description: Added export of the processed report as a standalone HTML file with report data and client experience embedded.
milestones.why: Created a portable output that could be shared independently of the builder.

milestones.title: Adaptive Content Journey
milestones.description: Adjusted content reporting to the actual campaign touch count: one-touch content focus, two-touch progression, and multi-touch journey/sequence treatment.
milestones.why: Prevented every campaign from being forced into the original four-touch narrative.

milestones.title: Conditional persona alignment
milestones.description: Made persona-related interpretation conditional on available mapped source data rather than assuming persona data always exists.
milestones.why: Reduced unsupported audience claims when a source file did not contain the needed persona field.

milestones.title: Large-account selector usability
milestones.description: Improved account-selection behavior so reports with more accounts remained usable instead of creating an unwieldy fixed list.
milestones.why: Improved report usability as the number of active accounts increased.

milestones.title: Expanded TAL coverage treatment
milestones.description: Refined TAL coverage presentation so named-account performance received more prominent and readable treatment in the report.
milestones.why: Made target-account performance easier to interpret for named-account programs.

milestones.title: Campaign target volume + target-aware pacing
milestones.description: Added an optional campaign target-volume input that enables target-aware executive pacing and completion context only when the supporting campaign target is supplied.
milestones.why: Made pacing more decision-useful without inventing progress-to-goal when the campaign target is unknown.
milestones.notes: Grounded in the Priority Intent / later Universal Builder lineage, where campaign target volume explicitly enables target-aware executive pacing.

milestones.title: Open-campaign vs TAL-aware logic
milestones.description: Kept open campaigns from using TAL-specific language while enabling target-account logic only when the relevant source is present.
milestones.why: Protected the meaning of the report across different campaign types.

milestones.title: Account, GEO, industry & audience intelligence
milestones.description: Expanded reporting across account reach, geography, industry, seniority, title/persona and company-size dimensions.
milestones.why: Moved the report from delivery totals toward a more useful view of who the campaign was reaching.

milestones.title: Account / domain identity handling
milestones.description: Added account-resolution behavior that uses account/domain context to consolidate and interpret account-level report activity.
milestones.why: Improved account-level reporting when company names vary across source records.

milestones.title: Firmographic segmentation
milestones.description: Added firmographic segmentation for SMB, Mid-Market, Enterprise and Large/Strategic account analysis when supported by employee/revenue data.
milestones.why: Made company-size composition and account mix visible to clients.

milestones.title: Evidence-aware enrichment handling
milestones.description: Refined enrichment behavior so unsupported firmographic values are left as insufficient/unknown rather than being silently invented.
milestones.why: Improved the defensibility of client-facing account intelligence.

milestones.title: Single-touch content pie
milestones.description: Added a single-touch-specific content visualization so one-touch campaigns did not inherit multi-touch content-journey presentation that did not fit the program structure.
milestones.why: Kept the generated report logic appropriate to the selected campaign type.
milestones.notes: Grounded in Avani_Universal_Report_Builder_v8_Single_Touch_Pie.html.

milestones.title: Integrated report logos
milestones.description: Integrated brand/logo handling into the early Universal Report Builder rather than treating logos as a manual post-export step.
milestones.why: Established branding as part of the reusable builder workflow from the first product iterations.
milestones.notes: Grounded in Avani_Universal_Report_Builder_v2_Integrated_Logos.html.

milestones.title: AVANI logo integration
milestones.description: Added AVANI branding directly into the builder experience as the product interface began to take shape.
milestones.why: Made the tool visibly an AVANI product rather than only a generated client report.
milestones.notes: Grounded in Avani_Universal_Report_Builder_v3_Avani_Logo.html.

milestones.title: Logo mark + client name presentation
milestones.description: Refined client branding so a logo mark could be paired with the client name when a complete wordmark was not available.
milestones.why: Improved brand readability when available logo assets were icon-only.
milestones.notes: Grounded in Avani_Universal_Report_Builder_v13_Logo_Mark_and_Client_Name.html.

milestones.title: Exact website wordmark lookup
milestones.description: Added a website-oriented lookup iteration intended to use the exact client wordmark associated with the supplied company site.
milestones.why: Improved accuracy of automatically sourced client branding.
milestones.notes: Grounded in Avani_Universal_Report_Builder_v14_Exact_Website_Wordmark.html.

milestones.title: Default wordmark-provider client ID
milestones.description: Added a default provider client-ID configuration to make higher-quality client wordmark lookup easier to use in the builder.
milestones.why: Reduced repetitive setup for the automated brand-asset workflow.
milestones.notes: Grounded in Avani_Universal_Report_Builder_v15_Default_Brandfetch_Client_ID.html.

milestones.title: Locked wordmark-provider client ID
milestones.description: Locked the provider client-ID configuration after testing so operators did not need to manage the integration value during normal builder use.
milestones.why: Reduced operator error and stabilized the automated wordmark workflow.
milestones.notes: Grounded in Avani_Universal_Report_Builder_v16_Locked_Brandfetch_Client_ID.html.

milestones.title: Trademarked product branding
milestones.description: Added the trademark treatment to AVANI REPORT BUILDER™ as the tool moved from an internal builder concept toward a named product.
milestones.why: Formalized the product identity used across later builder versions.
milestones.notes: Grounded in Avani_Universal_Report_Builder_v18_Trademarked.html.

milestones.title: Font-aligned rounded builder logo
milestones.description: Refined the builder header typography and rounded logo treatment to create a more cohesive software identity.
milestones.why: Improved visual consistency as AVANI REPORT BUILDER™ became a repeatable internal product.
milestones.notes: Grounded in Avani_Universal_Report_Builder_v21_Builder_Font_Aligned_Rounded_Logo.html.

milestones.title: Larger header branding
milestones.description: Expanded and refined the AVANI REPORT BUILDER™ header treatment so the product identity, actions and client-facing build workflow read more clearly as a software workspace.
milestones.why: Improved hierarchy and product recognition as the builder matured from a utility into a branded reporting application.
milestones.notes: Grounded in Avani_Universal_Report_Builder_v28_Larger_Header_Branding.html.

milestones.title: Client logo upload
milestones.description: Added a client branding input so the generated report could use an approved client logo or wordmark.
milestones.why: Made the generated output client-ready without editing the exported HTML by hand.

milestones.title: Automatic wordmark lookup
milestones.description: Added client-website-based lookup for the official company wordmark, with the goal of preserving the company name as part of the brand artwork.
milestones.why: Reduced manual brand-asset hunting when an official wordmark could be found automatically.

milestones.title: Wordmark image cleanup & header treatment
milestones.description: Added image processing to remove flat backgrounds, crop excess space, and prepare client brand assets for the report header.
milestones.why: Improved consistency of client branding in exported reports.

milestones.title: Full-wordmark preference + icon fallback control
milestones.description: Added logic and controls to prefer a full company wordmark while allowing a logo-mark fallback only when explicitly enabled.
milestones.why: Prevented the builder from silently substituting an icon where the client name was expected in the brand artwork.

milestones.title: Higher-quality wordmark provider configuration
milestones.description: Added a locked higher-quality wordmark lookup configuration plus a direct-image-URL fallback for approved brand assets.
milestones.why: Made automatic client branding more repeatable while preserving a manual path when lookup quality was insufficient.

milestones.title: Refined builder workspace
milestones.description: Reworked the builder layout and visual hierarchy so setup, data mapping, intelligence and report preview felt like a coherent software workspace.
milestones.why: Made the tool easier to operate as capabilities accumulated.

milestones.title: AVANI REPORT BUILDER™ product branding
milestones.description: Formalized the product identity and campaign-intelligence-generator framing inside the builder interface.
milestones.why: Shifted the work from a collection of report files into a recognizable product experience.

milestones.title: AI Campaign Strategist
milestones.description: Added an AI-assisted section for generating campaign-specific focus areas, callouts, recommendations and interpretation from aggregated campaign metrics.
milestones.why: Started moving the product from showing data toward explaining what the data means.

milestones.title: Local campaign-insight draft mode
milestones.description: Added a local rule-based generation mode for testing campaign insights without requiring an external AI connection.
milestones.why: Created a safe internal path to test the intelligence workflow before using the company AI workspace.

milestones.title: Company ChatGPT workflow
milestones.description: Added a workflow that prepares an aggregated campaign brief and exact response format for use in the approved company ChatGPT workspace.
milestones.why: Kept AI-assisted reasoning inside an approved workflow while avoiding lead-level personal data in the prompt.

milestones.title: Copy / Open ChatGPT workflow controls
milestones.description: Added direct builder controls to copy the prepared campaign prompt and open the company AI workspace for completion.
milestones.why: Reduced friction in the human-in-the-loop AI workflow.

milestones.title: Structured AI response import
milestones.description: Added import of the structured JSON response from the company AI workflow back into the report builder.
milestones.why: Turned AI output into structured report content instead of copy-paste prose scattered across the report.

milestones.title: AI writing-style controls
milestones.description: Added executive, concise and consultative writing-style options for campaign insight generation.
milestones.why: Allowed the intelligence layer to match the intended client communication style.

milestones.title: Human-reviewed strategic recommendations
milestones.description: Preserved a human review step for AI-assisted recommendations before they become part of client-facing output.
milestones.why: Kept strategic client recommendations reviewable rather than treating generated text as automatically publishable.

milestones.title: Priority intent treatment
milestones.description: Added priority-intent presentation to make stronger account signals more visible inside the reporting experience.
milestones.why: Helped clients distinguish accounts showing stronger opportunity signals from the broader account set.

milestones.title: Current Syndication Intent Super Score
milestones.description: Maintained an account-level Intent Super Score combining campaign/account depth, recency, geographic reach, persona/buying-group breadth, seniority coverage, content progression, TAL fit and external intent inputs.
milestones.why: Created a repeatable account-prioritization layer inside Syndication Studio.
milestones.notes: Current-state behavior is the parity baseline for the approved processor design.

milestones.title: Premium module organization
milestones.description: Refined the builder’s module structure so the growing set of report capabilities could be organized and managed more clearly.
milestones.why: Prevented the builder from becoming an unstructured list of toggles as capabilities expanded.

milestones.title: Interactive forecast driver
milestones.description: Added interactive forecast-driver capability to extend the report from current-state delivery into a more forward-looking reporting experience.
milestones.why: Expanded the product from descriptive reporting toward planning and expected-outcome context.

milestones.title: Published client report continuity
milestones.description: Kept the generated client report experience stable as the builder gained new source, branding and intelligence capabilities.
milestones.why: Allowed builder evolution without forcing clients to relearn or lose the established report experience.

milestones.title: Client-facing PDF / export continuity
milestones.description: Protected existing PDF and export behavior as the Syndication builder and intelligence layers evolved.
milestones.why: Preserved a client-facing delivery format while new features were added.

milestones.title: Weekly Pulse + Monthly Full Dashboard cadence
milestones.description: Standardize reporting into a deliberately simple weekly view for changes, pacing, health and action, plus the full Dashboard on a monthly cadence.
milestones.why: Creates a clearer client reporting rhythm without forcing the full report every week.

milestones.title: Webinar lead support
milestones.description: Add webinar leads alongside Syndication leads where the source data supports it.
milestones.why: Broadens Report Builder coverage beyond one lead source while preserving source identity.

milestones.title: Client-Provided lead support
milestones.description: Add client-provided leads as another reportable lead source.
milestones.why: Extends the report toward a fuller view of program demand sources.

milestones.title: Lead-source filters / toggles
milestones.description: Allow clients to view Syndication, Webinar, Client-Provided or combinations of those sources.
milestones.why: Keeps multi-source reporting understandable without flattening source differences.

milestones.title: State-level geographic view
milestones.description: Add a more useful state-level geographic view where the campaign data supports meaningful state analysis.
milestones.why: Makes geography more actionable for domestic campaign analysis.

milestones.title: Consolidated audience / role / title view
milestones.description: Clean up and consolidate the audience, role, seniority and title experience so related signals are easier to interpret together.
milestones.why: Reduces repetitive charts and clarifies the buying-audience story.

milestones.title: Custom Question Response intelligence
milestones.description: Add a dedicated CQ response section with visualization and drill-down into who selected each response.
milestones.why: Turns explicit qualification responses into visible client intelligence.

milestones.title: CQ-driven recommendations
milestones.description: Use CQ response patterns as inputs to report intelligence and recommendations where appropriate.
milestones.why: Shows additional value from thoughtfully designed CQs beyond collecting the answer itself.

milestones.title: Clear firmographic definitions
milestones.description: Keep SMB, Mid-Market, Enterprise and Large/Strategic segmentation while making the definitions transparent in the report.
milestones.why: Makes segment interpretation defensible and easier for clients to understand.

milestones.title: Multi-month / multi-publisher pacing
milestones.description: Improve pacing logic for longer-running campaigns and multiple publishers, separating period pacing from campaign-lifetime pacing and combined coverage.
milestones.why: Prevents campaign health from being distorted by timing or publisher-allocation differences.

milestones.title: More prominent ISS / quadrant experience
milestones.description: Make the Intent Super Score and opportunity quadrant more prominent and easier to understand.
milestones.why: Makes account-prioritization intelligence more usable for client decision-making.

milestones.title: Score-group guidance & filters
milestones.description: Add hover guidance and filters for the different ISS score groups / quadrants.
milestones.why: Explains what each score area means and lets clients inspect the relevant account set.

milestones.title: Lead / account counts inside score areas
milestones.description: Show the number of leads and accounts within each score area instead of relying only on score values.
milestones.why: Adds population context to the score distribution.

milestones.title: Parity-first ISS processor
milestones.description: Build a modular Intent & Enrichment processor for Campaign Leads, TAL, Bombora and ZoomInfo with auditable matching, standardized account intelligence, side-by-side ISS parity comparison and QA output.
milestones.why: The processor must reproduce the current ISS scores, bands and rankings before replacing the existing path.
milestones.notes: Approved design dated August 24, 2026; intentionally not marked shipped.

milestones.title: Expanded Account Intelligence
milestones.description: Expand company priorities, role-level priorities, likely concerns and strategic rationale inside the account intelligence layer.
milestones.why: Makes the report more useful for deciding how to follow up on high-priority accounts.

milestones.title: Prospect-company website intelligence
milestones.description: Pull relevant public themes from the prospect company website for grounded account context.
milestones.why: Adds company-specific context beyond campaign behavior alone.

milestones.title: Syndicated-content intelligence
milestones.description: Use the actual content being syndicated as an input to account and lead interpretation.
milestones.why: Connects campaign engagement to the themes the prospect was exposed to.

milestones.title: Client website / content intelligence
milestones.description: Use the client’s own website and content to ground recommendation and message alignment.
milestones.why: Keeps recommendations connected to what the client actually offers and says.

milestones.title: Client offering / message alignment
milestones.description: Tie prospect, role and content insights back to the client’s relevant messaging and offering.
milestones.why: Moves account intelligence toward practical, client-specific positioning.

milestones.title: Individual lead / account detail view
milestones.description: Create a dedicated detail view combining account, person, campaign, content, CQ and intent signals.
milestones.why: Provides a single place to understand why a specific lead or account matters.

milestones.title: SDR / BDR Battlecard add-on
milestones.description: Create a lead-level sales brief with company context, person context, content/CQ signals, likely concerns and suggested messaging.
milestones.why: Turns report intelligence into practical follow-up context for Sales.

milestones.title: Cross-channel Next Best Action
milestones.description: Strengthen recommendations across Syndication, Paid Media, ABM, Handraiser and related activation paths.
milestones.why: Moves the product from explaining what happened to helping clients decide what to do next.

milestones.title: Integrated Core + Named + Paid Media prototype
milestones.description: Built an integrated reporting prototype spanning Core and Named programs across Content Syndication and Paid Media.
milestones.why: Proved the cross-channel reporting model before building the dedicated Scale Studio.

milestones.title: Core / Named program separation
milestones.description: Structured the integrated report around separate Core and Named program views instead of blending all campaign activity together.
milestones.why: Preserved the distinct program strategies and audience definitions inside one report.

milestones.title: Cross-channel metric protection
milestones.description: Explicitly kept Paid Media outcomes separate from Content Syndication delivered leads and economics rather than summing unlike metrics.
milestones.why: Prevented an integrated report from creating misleading combined totals.

milestones.title: Reach → Capture → Advance executive story
milestones.description: Framed the unified report around how Paid Media builds reach, demand capture develops, and Named/CS activity advances account engagement.
milestones.why: Created an executive story across channels without pretending the channels use the same KPIs.

milestones.title: Scale client-only unified report
milestones.description: Produced a client-only campaign-intelligence report with executive story, program sections, Paid Media, content/creative, delivery/forecast, data trust and recommended actions.
milestones.why: Established the client-facing output that the dedicated Scale builder would generate and maintain.

milestones.title: Dedicated Scale Report Builder
milestones.description: Created a Scale-specific AVANI REPORT BUILDER™ instead of continuing to operate from the generic integrated prototype.
milestones.why: Gave Scale a maintainable product workflow tailored to its mixed-source reporting needs.

milestones.title: Separate Paid Media, Syndication & Named workspaces
milestones.description: Separated the builder into source-specific workspaces so Paid Media refresh, Content Syndication inputs and Named-account intelligence could be managed independently.
milestones.why: Reduced confusion and preserved the different operating logic of each source.

milestones.title: Story-led Content Syndication journey
milestones.description: Added a dedicated Content Syndication journey treatment inside the unified Scale report so delivery and content progression could be explained as a coherent story alongside Paid Media without collapsing the channels together.
milestones.why: Gave Content Syndication its own narrative role inside the unified client report rather than reducing it to a supporting table.
milestones.notes: Grounded in the dedicated Scale builder V15 lineage, which explicitly introduced a story-led Content Syndication journey.

milestones.title: Interactive volume pacing calendar
milestones.description: Added target-lead, planned-completion and weekly-wave inputs for Core and Named programs, with pacing calculated from supplied delivery waves and projections withheld when the required target or timing inputs are absent.
milestones.why: Made pacing and completion context interactive while protecting the client report from invented forecasts.

milestones.title: Weekly Hot Accounts configuration workspace
milestones.description: Integrated weekly Hot Accounts controls into the Scale builder, including report week, score threshold, Top N, source label, interest themes and optional mover/detail views.
milestones.why: Brought weekly named-account prioritization into the report-building workflow instead of treating it as a separate manual handoff.

milestones.title: Scale wordmark + official lookup controls
milestones.description: Embedded the approved Scale Computing wordmark as the default, added website-based official wordmark lookup, locked the higher-quality provider configuration, supported approved uploads/direct URLs, and kept logo-mark fallback opt-in.
milestones.why: Made the dedicated Scale report brand-safe while still supporting controlled replacement of approved client artwork.

milestones.title: Client-only generated preview
milestones.description: Made the Scale preview render the client-only report rather than exposing builder/internal controls in the output.
milestones.why: Made preview QA reflect the exact report experience intended for the client.

milestones.title: 1440px desktop preview canvas
milestones.description: Added a fixed desktop report canvas with builder-side scaling so the generated report could be reviewed at its intended desktop width.
milestones.why: Improved visual QA without forcing the builder window itself to be 1440px wide.

milestones.title: Open Preview in separate tab
milestones.description: Added a control to open the same generated client report in a separate browser tab for direct review.
milestones.why: Made it easier to inspect the client output outside the builder frame.

milestones.title: Standalone HTML export for Scale
milestones.description: Added download of the generated Scale client report as standalone HTML.
milestones.why: Kept a portable output path alongside live publishing.

milestones.title: Source-aware Paid Media readouts
milestones.description: Refined Paid Media narrative and metrics so readouts are tied to the actual source window and available source fields.
milestones.why: Reduced stale or unsupported narrative when the paid source changed.

milestones.title: Paid Media source refresh workflow
milestones.description: Added a dedicated refresh path for current Paid Media performance data and campaign collections.
milestones.why: Reduced repeated manual re-entry of Paid Media performance into the builder.

milestones.title: Paid Media refresh resilience
milestones.description: Made refresh behavior preserve the last confirmed Paid Media data when a newer refresh cannot return usable structured rows.
milestones.why: Prevents a temporary source failure from blanking or corrupting the active report.

milestones.title: Dynamic Paid Media source-window labels
milestones.description: Made Paid Media data-period labels reflect the actual loaded source period rather than relying on static reporting copy.
milestones.why: Keeps client-facing time-window context aligned with the source data.

milestones.title: Paid Media operational status controls
milestones.description: Added explicit in-flight status controls for Core/Named Paid Media programs and supporting channel/campaign states, including active, reactivated, optimization-watch and scheduled-conclusion context used in the generated report.
milestones.why: Let the client report distinguish performance from operational campaign state instead of inferring status from metrics alone.

milestones.title: Video completion benchmark context
milestones.description: Added an editable completion-reference percentage and benchmark label so video performance could be interpreted against client-provided context without presenting the benchmark as a builder-generated fact.
milestones.why: Provides useful performance context while preserving the provenance of the benchmark.

milestones.title: Campaign collections
milestones.description: Added campaign-level Paid Media collections so performance and creative evidence could be organized by campaign/ad instead of as one flat asset list.
milestones.why: Made creative and campaign review more usable inside the client report.

milestones.title: Campaign creative studio + mosaic asset wall
milestones.description: Built a visual Paid Media creative studio and mosaic asset wall so campaign creative could be browsed as part of the client report rather than only through source links or tables.
milestones.why: Turned creative evidence into a client-facing analysis experience and made the integrated report more useful for campaign review.
milestones.notes: Grounded in the Scale dedicated builder V15 lineage, which explicitly introduced the campaign creative studio and mosaic asset wall.

milestones.title: Paid Media campaign & creative matrix
milestones.description: Added a structured client-facing matrix by segment, platform, campaign, creative, status, ad set, key metric and asset links.
milestones.why: Connected Paid Media performance, operating state and creative evidence in one inspectable client view.
milestones.notes: Grounded in the generated Scale Computing Unified Campaign Intelligence client report.

milestones.title: Creative / asset synchronization
milestones.description: Added synchronization of supported creative links and asset evidence when the source data exposes a defensible campaign/ad match.
milestones.why: Reduced manual asset-library maintenance while avoiding unsupported creative attribution.

milestones.title: AgencyAnalytics PDF fallback refresh
milestones.description: Added PDF fallback import for refreshing performance KPIs, supported benchmark/week labels, readouts, pacing and trends without changing campaign creative links.
milestones.why: Created a fallback when row-level source data was not available.

milestones.title: CSV / XLSX row-level Paid Media fallback
milestones.description: Kept CSV/XLSX fallback support for row-level performance and campaign creative collections when the required columns are supplied.
milestones.why: Preserved a structured-data path when the primary refresh source was unavailable.

milestones.title: Data & Logic QA
milestones.description: Added an explicit Data & Logic QA stage for source reconciliation and client-output readiness.
milestones.why: Made report trust a first-class step instead of relying only on visual inspection.

milestones.title: Critical QA publish blocking
milestones.description: Blocked live publishing when Data QA detects unresolved critical reconciliation issues.
milestones.why: Prevents known critical data problems from reaching the client report.

milestones.title: Preview validation checkpoint
milestones.description: Made report preview validation one of the final checkpoints before publishing.
milestones.why: Adds visual/output review after data checks and before client delivery.

milestones.title: PDF color compatibility
milestones.description: Adjusted Scale report styling/export behavior to improve compatibility with PDF generation and avoid problematic rendered colors.
milestones.why: Kept the exported PDF visually usable without changing the live report design intent.

milestones.title: Strict manifest trial
milestones.description: Tested a stricter campaign/ad-to-asset manifest aligned to the available Paid Media evidence.
milestones.why: Explored a more defensible way to prove which creative belongs to each campaign/ad.

milestones.title: Automatic strict manifest
milestones.description: Automated manifest rebuilding when Paid Media campaign collections are loaded or refreshed.
milestones.why: Turned creative-evidence reconciliation into a repeatable builder process instead of a manual checklist.

milestones.title: Manifest matched / ambiguous / missing / retired states
milestones.description: Added manifest states that distinguish confirmed matches from ambiguous, missing-asset and retired/inactive cases.
milestones.why: Makes creative-evidence uncertainty explicit instead of silently treating every row as resolved.

milestones.title: Original live campaign sheet restored as source of truth
milestones.description: Re-centered the Paid Media operating workflow on the original live campaign sheet plus approved creative sources rather than a replacement source path.
milestones.why: Preserved the operating source the team already relied on while keeping the newer automation layers.

milestones.title: Dedicated live builder publishing
milestones.description: Added a dedicated workflow for publishing Scale builder updates to the permanent Scale builder location.
milestones.why: Separated builder deployment from report publication.

milestones.title: Dedicated live report publishing
milestones.description: Added a dedicated workflow for publishing the current generated Scale client report.
milestones.why: Made live report delivery a repeatable action inside the builder.

milestones.title: Private publisher key + token isolation
milestones.description: Kept the repository publishing credential outside the standalone builder HTML and required a private publish key for the connected route.
milestones.why: Reduced credential exposure in a client-report-building tool.

milestones.title: Publish confirmation safeguards
milestones.description: Added confirmation before replacing live builder or report index files.
milestones.why: Reduced accidental overwrites of live client/report assets.

milestones.title: Source refresh before live report publish
milestones.description: Made live report publishing refresh Paid Media and Content Syndication inputs before Data QA and report rebuild where possible.
milestones.why: Reduces the chance of publishing a stale report when newer source data is available.

milestones.title: Preserve last confirmed data on refresh failure
milestones.description: Kept the last confirmed Paid Media data active when a publish-time refresh could not complete.
milestones.why: Avoids replacing valid report data with an incomplete refresh result.

milestones.title: Immutable weekly report history
milestones.description: Archived the exact client report under a dated history path using Reporting End / Data Through when the live report is published.
milestones.why: Created a durable record of what the client report looked like at each reporting point.

milestones.title: Client-facing Reporting History
milestones.description: Surfaced saved dated report snapshots through the client-facing Reporting History control.
milestones.why: Lets clients move between reporting snapshots without receiving a different permanent report URL.

milestones.title: Published workspace restoration
milestones.description: Remembered the exact successfully published workspace on the same browser/device so builder inputs and imported data could be restored when the builder reopened.
milestones.why: Reduced repeated setup work and made the builder reopen closer to the last published state.

milestones.title: Clear remembered workspace control
milestones.description: Added a manual control to clear the stored last-published Scale workspace when a fresh setup is required.
milestones.why: Keeps workspace memory useful without trapping the user in an old state.

milestones.title: Richer weekly account movement
milestones.description: Make weekly movement in account-level Paid Media / Syndication signals easier to see and compare over time.
milestones.why: Adds a more useful temporal view of which accounts are strengthening or cooling.

milestones.title: Deeper Paid Media recommendations
milestones.description: Strengthen recommendations tied to Paid Media performance, creative patterns and account priorities.
milestones.why: Moves Scale reporting beyond channel reporting toward action guidance.

milestones.title: Cross-channel activation signals
milestones.description: Connect Paid Media, Syndication and account-level signals to identify where another activation motion is warranted.
milestones.why: Uses the unified Scale dataset to support better cross-channel decisions.

milestones.title: Improved Scale account detail
milestones.description: Create a deeper account-level view combining Paid Media, Syndication and Named-account context.
milestones.why: Makes the unified report more useful for account-level review and follow-up.

milestones.title: Scale Next Best Action framework
milestones.description: Evolve the Scale report toward clearer recommended actions across Paid Media, Syndication, ABM and Handraiser-style motions where relevant.
milestones.why: Extends the unified report from observing campaign performance into recommended activation.
